1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first component and second component are configured to provide a modular humeral implant system with interchangeable components of different sizes__.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface __component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature __and is configured to articulate with a glenoid surface__.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ is spherically or elliptically shaped __and includes a convex articulating surface__.

10. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface.

12. (Original) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a smooth articulating surface __for engagement with a glenoid component__.

14. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Original) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Original) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Original) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem __is selected from a plurality of stems of different lengths, wherein the selected stem__ extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw __connection mechanism__.

23. (Withdrawn) A humeral head surface protective guard comprising a protective surface.

24. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 23 further comprising a handle.

25. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 23 wherein said protective surface comprises a shell that is centrally cannulated.

26. (Withdrawn) The protective guard of claim 25 wherein said protective surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 2.0 mm.

27. (Currently Amended) __A glenohumeral joint implant system__ comprising __an implant adapted to provide__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and __the__ implant __configured for implantation in a glenohumeral joint__.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint __implant system__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant __component__.

29. (Currently Amended) __A humerus bone implant system__ comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface __component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of __a__ humerus bone __and wherein the modular implant provides joint reconstruction__.

30. (Currently Amended) The __humerus bone implant system__ of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently Amended) The __humerus bone implant system__ of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.

32. (Withdrawn) A humeral implant comprising a humeral surface component and no stem.
